description: This file defines the ACLController class for managing access control within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for checking user access, filtering modules based on permissions, and handling security features related to modules, categories, and user roles.

classes.name: ACLController
classes.description: Controller class for handling Access Control List (ACL) operations such as permission checks, module filtering, and access denial messaging within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a specific category and action, considering special cases like reports, products quotes, calendar, and activities.

methods.name: requireOwner
methods.description: Determines if the user needs to own the resource to access it, based on ACL rules.

methods.name: requireSecurityGroup
methods.description: Checks if the user needs to belong to a security group for access to a category.

methods.name: filterModuleList
methods.description: Filters a list of modules according to the user's access rights, removing modules for which the user lacks permission.

methods.name: checkModuleAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific module is permitted for the user based on actions permissions.

methods.name: disabledModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that are disabled for the user based on their permissions.

methods.name: addJavascript
methods.description: Adds JavaScript for ACL-related client-side controls for a category.

methods.name: moduleSupportsACL
methods.description: Determines if a module supports ACL based on the bean class implementation.

methods.name: displayNoAccess
methods.description: Displays an access denied message and optionally redirects the user to the home page.
